text_description: Full-length runway look centered on a sleeveless, body-skimming dress in deep taupe-brown with a plush, light-catching nap that reads as velvet or velour. The dress has a low rounded scoop neckline, narrow shoulder straps, bare arms, and a close fit through the chest, waist, and hips before falling into a longer, fluid skirt with soft vertical drag lines and gathered, irregular folds around the lower legs. The hem reaches to the ankle area and appears asymmetrically draped, with sections lifting and bunching to reveal tall glossy oxblood-burgundy boots underneath; the boots have a sleek shaft, high-shine surface, and rounded-to-slightly pointed toe visible at the front. Styling is minimal and earthy, with long loose wavy hair worn down and no prominent jewelry visible. In one hand, the model carries a small curved brown handbag or clutch with a pale gold-toned handle/edge detail and a thin dangling cord, adding a compact accessory against the elongated dress silhouette.
key_elements: body-skimming torso with fluid draped skirt
small curved brown hand-carried bag with pale gold-toned detail
uncertainty_notes: Fabric appears velvet or velour based on visible nap and sheen, but exact material is not confirmed.
The handbag structure is partially obscured by the hand and angle.
